the generation of MAbs to surface proteins of U266 cells.
the generation of MAbs against the unique cell-surface proteins of human multiple Myeloma.
the generation of MAbs to surface proteins of multiple myeloma, using murine in vivo method for immunization.

the immunogen concentration of an antigen used for immunization of mice has an effect on the quality of MAbs raised.

in vitro immunizations using membrane extracts of human multiple myelman cells can be a useful tool for the generation of myeloma-specific monoclonal antibodies.
the best immunization protocol for the production of MAbs to surface proteins of multiple myeloma cells is the intraperitoneal injection of 15 micro g of antigenic material.
in vivo immunization with membrane extracts of human multiple myelman cell lines can produce MAbs that are specific for surface markers of multiple myeloma.

the use of membrane extracts as immunogens is a viable option for generating MAbs against human multiple myelomas.
